summary: Treat the thus yotu discussion as an editorial note, not an example.

summary: Translate laying eggs rather than hatching them.

summary: Royal succession belongs to sense 5.

summary: Seat him too belongs to seating, not employment.

summary: Palace accommodation exemplifies lodging.

summary: The prohibition on waking illustrates the waking subsense.
rationale: PrS 83/94 repeats the existing quotation and explicitly contrasts sleep with being roused.

summary: File the example about seating someone under sense 1.
rationale: The supplied translation explicitly says 'to seat him as well/to make him sit down'. Stem III sense 1 is 'setzen … Platz nehmen lassen'; sense 2 is hiring someone as a servant. Nothing in this example indicates employment.

summary: New sense 3b: (als qoḏ̣e) das Richteramt antreten

summary: New sense 1b: (mit b-; gab-) unterbringen, wohnen lassen
rationale: Separate lodging from seating: rooms, a cave and a household supply residence locations. Already represented by the existing 71/21 example; causative counterpart of I.2.

summary: New sense 1c: einen Schlafenden aufsetzen lassen, wecken
rationale: Sleep and the prohibition on being roused support a distinct use, already present in the existing prs 243/24 example and confirmed in PrS 69/16.

summary: New sense 1b: (im Spiel) aussetzen, ausscheiden
rationale: 94/380 explicitly links koyotu with giving up the bat; with 94/378 this establishes the game penalty independently of the missing negation in 94/376. This overturns the earlier provisional rejection.

summary: New sense 1c: (mit mən-) von einer Tätigkeit ablassen
rationale: yatiwi mu ḥarbawo names the activity abandoned, with a repeated sitting clause; one clear constructional attestation.

data.turoyo: Fayiši, yatiwənne əšmo w azze kul ḥa b dukṯe, d doməx.
data.translation: Sie blieben ein wenig zusammensitzen; dann ging jeder an seinen Platz, um zu schlafen.

rationale: Unusual expanded finite yatiwənne; continued sitting followed by departure to sleep; segmentation remains an editorial question.

summary: example for sense 1 in Infectum (Hors 2/148)

data.turoyo: ʕAbiri, aṯən li qamaytaṯṯe ax xodume, məsqənne lu ṭaboqo d lalʕal, mətwənne bu diwan, <...>
data.translation: Als sie eintraten, kamen ihnen die Diener entgegen, führten siehinauf ins Obergeschoß und ließen sie im Besuchszimmer Platz nehmen. <...>

rationale: Thin III Infectum/1 cell; explicit agents, guests and reception-room location.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (LuF 2/32)

data.turoyo: Mšaḥalla maye w maḥatla b tašt, motawlali bu tašt. W mḥela raġla b arʕe du tašt, mṭawṭaḥlali bu šalwo, ʕal u talgo xrəqno.
data.translation: Sie machte Wasser heiss, tat es in einen Zuber und hiess mich in dem Zuber platznehmen (wörtl.: setzte mich in den Zuber). Dann gab sie dem Zuber einen Fusstritt und beförderte mich ins Tal hinab. Ich schlitterte über den Schnee.

rationale: Thin III Preterit/1 cell; explicit causative seating in a tub, with feminine agent and first-person patient.

summary: example for sense 2 in Preterit (PrS 10/3)

data.turoyo: Mutwila sann noše roʕe. Šato yo, tarte yo, kroʕən aʕ ʕeze dann noše.
data.translation: Als sie heranwuchsen und älter wurden, verschaffte sie ihnen bei den Leuten als Hirten ein Unterkommen; ein bis zwei Jahre hindurch weideten sie die Ziegen;

rationale: First III Preterit example for employment sense 2; role roʕe and employer s-ann noše support placement in service.

summary: example for sense 2 in Preterit (PrS 17/2)

data.turoyo: Kətwo ḥa faqiro, mawtawwe baqoro. <...>
data.translation: auch ein Armer lebte dort, den man als Kuhhirt angestellt hatte. <...>

rationale: Thin III Preterit/2 cell; cowherd role with an indefinite appointing agent.

summary: example for sense 1b in Preterit (PrS 22/18)

data.turoyo: Mamṭele i ḥoṯo w barṯe du šex daǧ ǧən lu bayto, mhirole aʕle w i ḥoṯo mətwole gabe.
data.translation: Jener aber führte seine Schwester und die Tochter des Elfenkönigs nach Hause und vermälte sich mit der letzteren, wärend er seine Schwester bei sich wohnen liess.

rationale: First III Preterit/1b example; the sister is housed with her brother, distinct from seating.

summary: example for sense 1b in Infectum (PrS 33/4)

data.turoyo: <...> mətwənne bu quṣro, <...>
data.translation: <...> In diesem Schlosse liessen sie sie wohnen, <...>

rationale: First added III Infectum/1b example; residence in a castle, complementing the refiled 71/21 example.

summary: example for sense 1b in Preterit (PrS 34/41)

data.turoyo: Məblile lu baḥri li awdaye. Kit ḥḏo bi awdaye su baḥri, ṭaw mena layt, əšma Nure. Mətwile gaba lu baḥri.
data.translation: Hier brachte er sie in ein Zimmer, in welchem sich schon ein wunderschönes Mädchen, Namens Nûre, befand; bei dieser liess der Meermann die beiden wohnen.

rationale: III Preterit/1b: accommodation with a named co-resident and explicit plural patients.

summary: example for sense 1b in Preterit (PrS 44/54)

data.turoyo: Ummo: "Kətwo ḥḏo bi ʕayno dam maye, alyaq mena latwo, mədlila, mədla l droʕi, mamṭəlali taḥt i arʕo, aṯyono larke, mawtawlali bi mʕarṯaṯi."
data.translation: »In der Wasserquelle«, sagte sie, »war eine einzig schöne Frau, die wollte ich greifen, aber sie fasste meinen Arm und zog mich unter die Erde, bis ich hierher gelangte, dann liess sie mich in dieser Höle wohnen.«

rationale: Thin III Preterit/1b cell; forced residence in a cave, keeping the edition's own German.

summary: example for sense 2 in Preterit (PrS 60/44)

data.turoyo: Omər more di raḥyo: "L əno mawtawli, hat knaykət an noše, lə kṭəreno d yətwət gabi, u ḥmoro kayiso yo." — komər more di raḥyo.
data.translation: Jener aber antwortete: "Ich selbst habe ihn dorthin gesetzt, du buhlst ja mit den Leuten, solche Diener kann ich nicht brauchen, der Esel ist brav."

rationale: Thin III Preterit/2 cell; first-person appointing agent; animal worker is a participant extension.

summary: example for sense 1c in Preterit (PrS 69/16)

data.turoyo: Aṯino, damixo wox, lə mawtawlilox, azzi li sato d qəṭaʕno əšme d ʕənwe, msəkno bu faḥo."
data.translation: darum bin ich hergekommen, als du dich schon schlafen gelegt hattest, und habe dich nicht wecken wollen, sondern bin zum Weinstock gegangen, um etwas Trauben abzuschneiden; dabei habe ich mich in der Falle gefangen."

rationale: First III Preterit/1c example; negated rousing after an explicit sleeping frame.

summary: example for sense 1b in Preterit (66/214)

data.turoyo: Omər: "Qum mobannux." Nafəl Bakkoye ʕAwan b qamutṯe w mobele s Be Qara Taždin, motawle s Be Qara Taždin."
data.translation: "Steh auf, ich werde dich hinbringen!" Bakko Awan ging vor ihm her und brachte ihn zum Hause Tadschdin. Dort ließ er ihn Wohnung nehmen.

rationale: Thin III Preterit/1b cell; a named household as lodging place, with listed motaw- regional form.

summary: example for sense 1b in Infectum (94/380)

data.turoyo: Iḏa d oṯe, xəd məlli aqdam, noqəṣ mi čamke qariwo li ḥəlle, koyotu, yaʕni komaflət i čamke m iḏe.
data.translation: Wenn, wie gesagt, das Flugholzweniger weit von der Freistau hinfällt, als das Schlagholz lang ist, d. h. nahe bei ihr hinfallt, so "setzt sich" der Schleuderer und gibt das Schlagholz ab.

rationale: New technical sense 1b; the Turoyo explanation giving up the bat supports exclusion without relying on the German alone.

summary: example for sense 1c in Preterit Intransitive (99/111)

data.turoyo: Komər tamo komər aṯən, kəmmi, yatiwi mu ḥarbawo, komər kulle yatiwi.
data.translation: Da kamen sie, gaben den Krieg auf und setzten sich alle hin (ließen ab vom Kampfe).

rationale: New construction sense 1c; m- explicitly marks fighting as the activity abandoned.

summary: example for sense 2 in Infectum (115/100)

data.turoyo: <...> Annaqla, ya aḥuno, komər gmoṭina li walaye, marfi komər u hafṣoro du səsyayḏux w ḥozina, p ayna tarʕo d kole, tamo gtowina ḏ̣ayfe aʕlayye! <...>
data.translation: <...> Darum, Bruder, wenn wir zu der Stadt kommen, so laß deinem Pferd den Halfter los und laß uns sehen, an welchem Tore es stehen bleibt! Dort wollen wir bei den Leuten zu Gast bleiben. <...>

rationale: Thin Infectum/2 cell and contracted gtowina; ḏ̣ayfe plus ʕal-hosts establishes guest lodging.

summary: example for sense 2 in Preterit-wa (115/270)

data.turoyo: Rawixi ʕal as səsyaṯṯe, komər malaxxe, daʕiri disane, aṯən li škafte, d yatiwiwa eba, u yawmo, d huwwanne, d maṭənne daǧ ǧənnat, d əmmina. Maṭən ʕaṣriye li škaftayo.
data.translation: Sie bestiegen ihre Pferde, ritten zurück und kamen wieder zu der Höhle, in der sie damals gesessen hatten, an dem Tage, da man ihnen all das gegeben hatte, daß sie zu ihnen kamen, d. h. zu der Höhle der Geister. Sie kamen abends bei der Höhle an.

rationale: Thin Preterit-wa/2 cell; anterior stay at a cave, retaining the complete current-verse context.

summary: example for sense 1 in Preterit (104/9)

data.turoyo: Mawtatle a tre wazirayḏe b dukṯo w zbəṭle u adras dəṯṯe gabe w hiye qayəm, azzele l ḥḏo qaḥwa w yatu bi qaḥwa.
data.translation: Da ließ er seine beiden Wesire an einem orte zurück, nahm ihre Adresse an sich, ging zu einem Kaffeehause und setzte sich dort hin.

rationale: Unusual Mawtatle with two ministers as patients; preserve surface form without changing the inherited mawtaw- paradigm.

summary: Restore the English grammatical comment as a note, preserving its uncertainty.

data.append_stem_note: thus yotu is ‘he lives,’ while yatiwo-yo is ‘he sits, he is seated.’ We shall have to doublecheck it (I’d say this is not true. See examples under 2) in Part. Act - Nikita)

rationale: These two rows together form English prose: 'thus yotu is … while yatiwo-yo is …', followed by an explicit editorial request to double-check the claim. 'thus' is not Turoyo, and 'is … while' is not an example translation. Move the whole comment, including the doubt and attribution, to a stem note without deciding its linguistic claim.

summary: Restore the consonant order in the word for rats.
rationale: The supplied verse 1/49 has 'aʕ ʕubbugre bənne', with g before r. The same sentence under nṭr I Infectum-wa sense 2 also has 'aʕ=ʕubbugre'. The entry reverses these consonants; this is not a clitic or vowel normalization.

summary: Sense 1: revise the gloss
rationale: Adds the maintained seated state explicitly: the existing 24/14 example and the checked finite and Part act. contexts describe both sitting and sitting down.

summary: New idiom: qyomo w itowo ‘Tun und Lassen, die Angelegenheiten’

data.headword: qyomo w itowo ‘Tun und Lassen, die Angelegenheiten’
data.turoyo: <...> U qyomo w itowo wazirayḏe we, Titəlyos we.
data.translation: <...> Was immer der König tat, das bestimmte sein Wesir Titiliyos.

rationale: Posture merism for the king's affairs; search for itowo found no existing separate collocation. One attestation, interpretation remains open to editor confirmation.

summary: Routine counts represent 1,044 additional analysed occurrences, not 1,044 extra decision lines. Sitting is dominant: I Preterit Intransitive/1 476, Part act./1 221, Infectum/1 109, Imperativ/1 83. Counts describe reader assignments and do not independently resolve ambiguous forms.

The qaṭəl/Part act. opposition is not equivalent to sit/live: both finite and Part act. forms express residence, while finite forms also describe sustained sitting. Female yatiwo is parsimoniously finite feminine; yatuto is the usual feminine Part act. Do not infer agreement levelling solely from the homograph.
After removing the two metalinguistic lines, Part act./2 has two existing substantive quotations, not the four raw parsed records or the reader's repeated count of five.

The inherited Detransitive Infinitiv box contains ordinary action nominals, including possessed itowo and feminine itawto. Keep its filing without claiming a Detransitive event reading. Negative fayəš plus personal suffix scopes over the availability of staying.

III shows seating, lodging and waking with explicit causees; -la/-li agent and object suffixes must be distinguished. III accommodation and waking already occurred in the source entry and are now explicitly subdivided.

Printed prs page/line references and local PrS text/verse references differ systematically; preserve both as concordance evidence. Search for raḥa confirmed the existing 11/225 quotation but no separate new idiom is justified by the present input.

Preserved editorial text relocated from ytw.I.t.part-act.7–8: thus yotu is ‘he lives,’ while; yatiwo-yo is ‘he sits, he is seated.’ We shall have to doublecheck it (I’d say this is not true. See examples under 2) in Part. Act - Nikita)

Batch 2 retains every earlier change and the labels 3b, III.1b and III.1c. New I.1b is justified by 94/380 giving up the bat, overturning batch 1's rejection for lack of independent Turoyo support; the source-negation question at 94/376 remains.
99/111 supplies a source-marked cessation construction, not just a participant extension of sitting. The ordinary second yatiwi reinforces its posture basis.
The target phrase gfayšiwa yatiwe in Talay 2/28 is absent from the supplied German. It can inform analysis of continued inactivity but cannot furnish an aligned published example.
Confirm finite feminine yatiwo in Hors 2/74, JTM 4.5/13, PrS 34/28, 34/55, 78/7 and 78/93 against Part act. yatuto; do not assume an invariant feminine predicate.
Is LuF 2/25 (existing LuF 282/25) specifically cohabitation, or only illicit current sitting together? Preserve the inherited assignment until clarified.
Confirm itawto as an event noun versus a place noun in MAC MuA The Story of Xalaf Agha/40; no place sense has been added.
Resolve taw in PrS 44/49: sitting command, coming command or exhortation? No discourse sense is accepted without root identification.
Collate missing negation in 57/15 and 94/376 before using their German refusal/exclusion translations as semantic evidence.
Confirm ktaw initial k- (67/124), yatiwənne expansion (78/27), yatiwani deictic segmentation (64/205), and yatiwi after klen (PrS 43/84).
Confirm whether noše lo koyotu (94/164) has generic singular agreement, a contracted plural or a source error.

Check local/print concordances: PrS 1/7 = prs 1/16, PrS 15/41 = prs 32/3, PrS 15/51 = prs 32/21, PrS 63/20 = prs 177/9; MAC NI Fingan Agha and Sultan Hasan/61 corresponds to inherited Fənǧan Aġa 53 NI. No print reference is silently replaced.
Is final aṯi w yatu (JTM 4.2/18) a conventional staying closure? Does PrS 18/57 permit lodging rather than the German dismounting? These do not establish new senses.
Does game koyotu require actual sitting or only surrendering the turn? 94/380 supports technical exclusion even while the missing negation in 94/376 remains to be collated.
Confirm whether the qyomo w itowo merism in 97/3 denotes all affairs or specifically administrative dependence on the adviser.
Verify Mawtatle at 104/9 against the edition; preserve the form and keep it separate from the unrelated existing women-seating quotation.
Provide or verify the edition's omitted German for gfayšiwa yatiwe in Talay 2/28; no substitute translation has been supplied.
Correct German Gerberge to Herberge.
rationale: The supplied translation of 36/35 reads 'gegenüber der Herberge'; 'Gerberge' is a misspelling.

summary: Correct the spelling of nebeneinander.
rationale: German 'nebeneinander' is misspelled as 'nebenainander'.

summary: Animal sitting and brooding preserve core posture; a wedding company or council denotes its sitting participants. No separate senses for subject type.
Temporary lodging and return-home settlement share the residential frame with permanent settlement.
Employment can be expressed with a bare role noun, employer gab-/s-, or qm and a work charge; animals in fables occupy the same worker role.
Remaining inactive or awaiting an endpoint can be inferred from sitting plus ʕal aṯe, negation or hol d; no independently established lexical 'accept', 'begin', or 'wait' sense.
